private_lines.Sinéad: You work as a substitute teacher, moving between classes at the school at short notice, and you live alone in a rented flat in Galway city.
private_lines.Tomás: You teach full time and coordinate PE and games, so your days are spent on the yard and in the hall, and you live alone in a house in Galway, where you walk the Salthill prom most evenings.
private_lines.Ailbhe: You run the school day to day and drive to it each morning, and you also carry out inspections elsewhere, so your days are full of meetings and paperwork, and you live alone in a house in Galway, where you go running in the evenings.
private_lines.Darragh: You are a newly qualified teacher with your own class, so your evenings go on planning and marking, and you rent a room in a shared house in Galway city, where you live alone in your own flat and play five-a-side on Tuesdays.
private_lines.Maeve: You work part time with small groups of pupils on reading recovery and learning support, and you live alone in a house in Galway, where you tend the garden and volunteer at the local library.

text: Reminder to sign the sign in sheet in the office before you leave if you were in today. Ailbhe asked me to say 🙏
On it
Which one, the yellow one by the photocopier?
Yeah
Signed. I was in the library pm, not sure if that counts
Wait is it for tmrw too
No just today. Tmrw is the usual sheet
Signed. Yard duty was a mess today 🙄
Room 4 sheet still blank
Room 4 is me, signed it at 3
Ok
Night all 😴
Morning. Inspector coming in on the 9th. Can someone check the Room 4 timetable is on the wall and not in a drawer
It's on the wall. Took it down for the photocopier then forgot
I'll put it back up
Hall is booked 1-2 for the Christmas thing, not 12-1 like I said. Sorry
Ok thanks Tomás
Anyone know where the big Oxford Reading Tree box went? Reading group 3 wants it and it's not in the cupboard
It's in the PE store. I put it in there when the cupboard flooded 🙄
Ah. Thanks
Sinéad you're in 3rd today, Ms Kenny has the flu. Lesson plans in the blue folder
Ok 👍 the blue folder is empty
Check under the desk. It's there
Found it 😅
Anyone want the spare hurleys? We have 6 and nobody to use them
Could use one for 5th class Monday if they're going out
Take 2, they're in the hall corner
Home. Anyone need anything from the library? I'm going in Saturday
Nah. Thanks
Can someone tell me if the 6th class trip form got in? Office only has 4
Not sure, I was in 3rd all day. Forms were in the tray by the office maybe?
Yep, I took the 6th class ones over at lunch. Left them under the bulletin board, sorry
Ok, four is fine. I'll just count
Is Friday assembly still on?
9.10 in the hall. Darragh you're on the mic
Why me
Because you're the only one who gives it back
9.10 yes
Planning 5th class maths till my eyes go. 40 sheets
Go to bed
Can't, the sheets are not going to write themselves
Night
Morning. Can someone grab a toner from the store before 9? Office one is dead
Store key is on my hook. I'll get it at 8:30
Thanks
Does the mic work or do I need to shout
Works if you hold it like you mean it
Morning. I'm in 2nd today. Is there a plan for Ms Fahy's class or do I wing it 😅
Plan is in the blue folder
Is it under the desk again
Check the desk
👀 ok
Anyone know if the Oxford box is back in the cupboard or still in the PE store
Still in the PE store. Come get it, it's heavy
I'll send Darragh
Not my job
Done with the 40 sheets. Don't ask
Did you sleep
Some
6th class trip forms: 26 back, 4 still out. Could whoever gave them out chase the rest? Thanks
On it. Declan's mam is always last 🙄
She'll sign it Monday at the gate
Home. Friday assembly went fine Darragh, you didn't drop the mic once
Only the once
Only the once is a lot for a mic
Up. Anyone need cover Monday? Free all day 🙏
Not yet, I'll let you know by Sunday
Ok 👍
Salthill was freezing tonight. The sea was practically on the road
You're mad walking in that
Mad and fed up of the house
Five-a-side is Tuesday, I'm not playing tonight before anyone asks
Nobody asked
Going to bed. Really this time
Night
